Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with chest pain followed by loss of consciousness

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 88-year-old male patient with a history of hypertension received their second dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 5mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Approximately 4 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed chest pain followed by loss of consciousness.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Kim (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter441@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
